nights.title: Brutalismus 3000: Harmony US Tour 2026
nights.name: Brutalismus 3000
nights.extract: Brutalismus 3000 are an electronic music duo from Berlin, comprising Victoria Vassiliki Daldas and Theo Zeitner.

nights.title: Strawberry Guy
nights.name: Strawberry Guy
nights.extract: Alexander Morgan Stephens, better known by his stage name Strawberry Guy, is a Welsh indie pop musician. He is best known for his 2019 single "Mrs Magic", which gained popularity via TikTok.
